title: 假画
blurb_en: A famous painting at a Beijing auction house turns out to be fake. It was real a week ago, and the young assistant who spotted it becomes the main suspect.
blurb_zh: 拍卖行里的一幅名画，被发现是假的。一个星期以前，它还是真的。发现它的年轻助理，成了最大的嫌疑人。
